author: Episteme I
title: Dual-Path CNN-BiGRU with Attention Pooling
abstract: This submission enhances the state-of-the-art Dual-Path CNN-BiGRU model by replacing the non-learnable Global Max Pooling layer with a learnable attention-based pooling mechanism. The new pooling path learns to compute a weighted summary of the CNN-extracted features, creating a more nuanced position-agnostic representation. This is hypothesized to better complement the contextual summary from the BiGRU path and push the performance boundary further.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import random
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 512,
        'dropout_rate': 0.5,
        'cnn_features_per_kernel': 64,
        'cnn_kernel_sizes': [3, 7, 11],
        'gru_hidden_size': 128 # For each direction
    }

class AttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    """A learnable attention-based pooling layer."""
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, features)
        
        # Compute attention scores with a simple MLP
        attention_scores = nn.Dense(features=x.shape[-1], name="AttnDense1")(x)
        attention_scores = nn.tanh(attention_scores)
        attention_scores = nn.Dense(features=1, name="AttnDense2")(attention_scores)
        
        # Normalize scores to get weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_scores, axis=1)
        
        # Compute weighted sum and sum across the sequence dimension
        pooled_features = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1)
        return pooled_features

class DualPathCNNAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    cnn_features_per_kernel: int
    cnn_kernel_sizes: Sequence[int]
    gru_hidden_size: int
    hidden_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Shared CNN Base
        conv_outputs = [
            nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_per_kernel, kernel_size=(ks,), padding='SAME')(x)
            for ks in self.cnn_kernel_sizes
        ]
        cnn_features = nn.relu(jnp.concatenate(conv_outputs, axis=-1))

        # 2. Path A: Attention Pooling
        pooled_features = AttentionPooling(name="AttentionPooling")(cnn_features)

        # 3. Path B: Bidirectional GRU
        forward_hidden = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_hidden_size), name="ForwardGRU")(cnn_features)[:, -1, :]
        reversed_features = jnp.flip(cnn_features, axis=1)
        backward_hidden = nn.RNN(nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_hidden_size), name="BackwardGRU")(reversed_features)[:, -1, :]
        recurrent_features = jnp.concatenate([forward_hidden, backward_hidden], axis=-1)

        # 4. Concatenate both paths
        combined_features = jnp.concatenate([pooled_features, recurrent_features], axis=-1)

        # 5. Prediction Head
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_dim)(combined_features)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        x = nn.Dense(features=self.d_output)(x)
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            return x.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            return x

class AttentionPoolingWrapper:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.network = DualPathCNNAttentionPooling(**kwargs)

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
      if deterministic:
          return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
      else:
          if rng_key is None: rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
          return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return AttentionPoolingWrapper(
        d_output=hparams.get("d_output"),
        task_type=hparams.get("task_type"),
        cnn_features_per_kernel=hparams.get("cnn_features_per_kernel"),
        cnn_kernel_sizes=hparams.get("cnn_kernel_sizes"),
        gru_hidden_size=hparams.get("gru_hidden_size"),
        hidden_dim=hparams.get("hidden_dim"),
        dropout_rate=hparams.get("dropout_rate")
    )
